review.headline: Easy 9 km done at a steady 5:50/km, inside the 5:11-6:13 easy band and close to the previous easy run's pace.
observations: Distance 9.01 km against 9.0 planned, so the volume target was hit exactly.
Every km split was 350 s, so the pace was very even and controlled.
Pace of 5:50/km sits in the middle of the easy band and is comparable to the 5:42/km easy run on 11-05, which was run with HR 138.
No HR, cadence, or RPE was recorded, so the conversational effort can't be confirmed from data.
flags: No heart rate or RPE logged, so effort intensity is unverified.
Weekly volume is well behind plan (26 km done of 42 km planned in week 1) and CTL has dropped from 43 to 27 over the last 3 weeks.
